state.mensaje: Tengo una incidencia con la entrega de Sofá Boreal Compact; no coincide con la fecha que aparecía al comprar.

case_type.instructions: FraSoHome is a home furniture and decor retailer. Which support queue should handle this customer message? Pick the primary problem.

criteria.devolucion: Return or refund of an item already purchased: return status, refund not received, return paperwork
criteria.info_producto: Pre-purchase product question: dimensions, materials, fit in the customer's space, alternatives
criteria.entrega: Delivery of an order: late, in transit, tracking, delivery date mismatch
criteria.defecto: Product arrived damaged, defective, with missing parts or a finishing problem
criteria.stock_tienda: Stock availability of a product in a physical store or unclear availability on the website
criteria.cupon: Promo code, coupon or campaign discount that fails or was not applied
criteria.fidelizacion: Loyalty programme: points, tier, club benefits not showing

frustration.instructions: How frustrated does the customer sound in this message?

is_blocked.instructions: Is the customer currently unable to use a product or complete a purchase until FraSoHome acts?

criteria.true: Something is broken, missing, late or blocking a purchase right now
criteria.false: An informational question or a status check with no blocker
